title: http-errors
author: George Chatzisofroniou
description: This script crawls through the website and returns any error pages. The script will return all pages (sorted by error code) that respond with an http code equal or above 400. To change this behaviour, please use the errcodes option. The script, by default, spiders and searches within forty pages. For large web applications make sure to increase httpspider's maxpagecount value. Please, note that the script will become more intrusive though.
